WTOP News on Instagram: "After more than 40 years, the Safeway at the Hechinger Mall in Northeast D.C. is set to close its doors for the final time on May 16. Its pharmacy will close on April 1.

Read more at WTOP.com or on the WTOP app. Link in bio.
